posts.name: Mohammad Ibrahim Ansari
posts.cooked: Since the oppe will be on the vm will we only join the google meet or will there be some link we’ll have to join as well to share our screen and stuff?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Screen sharing is handled in exam portal just like any other OPPE you have to join an exam portal and accept to the code of conduct and instructions. Only after that, you move on to the terminal and SSH into the VM.
